captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a professional 35mm T1.5 cinema prime lens. It features a matte black cylindrical main body with white and orange text markings indicating "35" and "T1.5" on the front barrel. A wide, ribbed focus-marking ring with white scale tick marks is positioned around the center of the barrel, and a silver-colored PL locking ring with black grip ridges is located at the rear mount. The focus ring rotates continuously around the optical axis, while the PL locking ring rotates on a separate revolute joint to simulate locking onto a camera mount.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a 35mm T1.5 cinema prime lens. The lens should feature a black cylindrical main body with orange and white text markings, a central ribbed focus ring with white scale tick marks, and a silver-colored PL locking ring at the rear. Ensure both the focus ring and the PL locking ring are modeled as articulated parts capable of rotating around the central Z-axis.
captions.factory: The code constructs the lens using a series of nested cylinder primitives for the main lens body, the focus ring, and the rear mount. Text markings ('35' and 'T1.5') are extruded and positioned on the outer surface of the main barrel. The focus ring is detailed by polar-patterning rectangular teeth and rectangular tick marks around its circumference. The PL locking ring is constructed with similar radial grip teeth and a locking tab, and is defined as a separate child part connected to the main body via a revolute joint.
